snippet.title: Cleo Abram
snippet.description:
Video journalist making optimistic tech explainers. Huge If True.

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cleoabram
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cleoabram 
Twitter: https://twitter.com/cleoabram

If you'd like to sponsor a Huge If True episode, reach out at the email below.

If you're looking for my bio, here it is:
Cleo Abram is a video journalist who produces Huge If True, an optimistic show about science and technology. Huge If True is an antidote to the doom and gloom, helping a wide audience see better futures they can help build. In each episode, Cleo dives deep into one innovation that could shape the future. She has explored humanoid robots at Boston Dynamics, supersonic planes at NASA, quantum computers at IBM, the Large Hadron Collider at CERN, and more. Previously, Cleo was a video producer at Vox and directed for Explained on Netflix. She was the host of Vox’s first ever daily show, Answered, as well as co-host of Vox’s YouTube Originals show, Glad You Asked.

snippet.title: SolarCraft
snippet.description:

Since 1984, we've helped homeowners, businesses, wineries, and agricultural properties lower energy costs with expert solar panel installation, battery storage systems, backup power solutions, and EV charger installations.

As a trusted California solar contractor, SolarCraft provides turnkey clean energy solutions, including system design, permitting, installation, monitoring, and support. Our licensed and certified solar professionals are committed to quality craftsmanship, high-performance systems, and exceptional customer service.

Whether you're interested in home solar, commercial solar, battery backup, or EV charging, we make the transition to clean energy simple and affordable. Subscribe for solar tips, project showcases, customer stories, and the latest renewable energy insights.

snippet.title: Jonathan Tracey
snippet.description:
Welcome! I’m JT — solar nerd, battery addict, heat-pump convert, and EV enthusiast for the past 15 years.

This channel is all about real-world energy: no fluff, no sales pitch, just honest results from running my own home on solar, batteries, heat pumps, and smart energy tech.

My mission?

snippet.title: Tim & Kat's Green Walk
snippet.description:
We are Tim and Kat and we live on the edge of the Cotswolds in the beautiful English countryside.  Join us on our journey to make our home and lives more sustainable as we add solar panels, battery storage, and other technologies to our house.  Plus we'll be covering our experiences as first time EV owners, and we are also experimenting with replacing some consumable products with more environmentally friendly alternatives.  Oh, and Tim might talk about compost occasionally.

Please note that Tim is not a professional consultant, just an enthusiastic amateur, so cannot reply to requests for advice or opinions on specific systems or green investment opportunities.  Thank you for your understanding.

snippet.title: DW News
snippet.description:
Journalism that’s Made for Minds. Follow us for global news and analysis from the heart of Europe. DW News delivers the world's breaking news while going deep beneath the surface of what's going on. Correspondents on the ground and in the studio provide their detailed analysis and insights on issues that affect our viewers. 

Deutsche Welle is Germany’s international broadcaster, producing content in 30 languages. We independently report social, political and economic developments in Germany and Europe, incorporating both German and other perspectives. DW hopes to promote understanding between different cultures and peoples. 

While funded by the German government, the work of DW is regulated by the Deutsche Welle Act (http://p.dw.com/p/17MtP), meaning content is always independent of government influence. 

We ask that you please keep comments and discussions on this channel clean and respectful. For further information please click the 'DW Netiquette' link below.
